svg.title: DIDComm-based SSI wallet with VDR push channel
svg.desc: Architecture showing a holder wallet communicating with issuer, verifier, and a VDR Watcher service over DIDComm v2. The watcher subscribes to ledger events and pushes notifications about DID document updates, revocations, and registry changes to the wallet through a mediator. All cryptographic and protocol activity is exposed in a behind-the-scenes transparency log.

g.text: Decrypts, authenticates, dispatches by protocol type
Verifies watcher signature, applies event to local state
Decides: alert user, refuse to present, auto re-fetch

svg.text: Solid arrows: DIDComm encrypted messages · Dashed: internal calls · Watcher signs every notify with its DID
Wallet only trusts watchers it has explicitly subscribed to — opt-in, revocable, multiple allowed
